name: forward_generated_artifact
description: Plan A end-to-end smoke graph. The agent first generates an image with image_generation, then forwards the resulting document via http_request multipart using $attachment:<document_id>. Used by tests/attachment_uniform_resolution_test.rs (under #[ignore], requires OPENAI_API_KEY).

config.system_prompt:
You are an upload agent. Workflow:
1. Call generate_image once to produce an image. The response contains images[0].attachment_id.
2. Call http_upload with body = { "file": "$attachment:<attachment_id>" } using the attachment_id from step 1.
Do not skip tools. Do not invent placeholders.

generate_image.name: generate_image
generate_image.description: Generate a brand-new image from a text prompt. Returns { images: [{ attachment_id, ... }] }. Pass the attachment_id to http_upload as '$attachment:<attachment_id>'.

prompt.description: Detailed text prompt describing the image to generate.

http_upload.name: http_upload
http_upload.description: Upload a generated artifact as multipart/form-data to the KB endpoint. The body must be {"file": "$attachment:<attachment_id>"} where <attachment_id> is the value returned by generate_image.

body.description: Must be { "file": "$attachment:<attachment_id>" } using the value from generate_image.
